outputLangInstruction:
## Output language requirement (highest priority, second only to aspect-ratio and page-count hard constraints)
All user-visible text in the generated deck (heading, text, list, badge, button label, card titles, etc.) MUST be in **English**. Translate user input to English even if it is provided in another language. If the user message explicitly requests another language, follow the user.
